name: cineflix-backend-tests
description: REST API tests using BDD with Cucumber, Gherkin, Playwright and TypeScript

scripts.test: cucumber-js --require-module ts-node/register --require features/step-definitions/**/*.ts --require features/support/**/*.ts features/**/*.feature --format html:reports/cucumber-report.html
scripts.test:tag: cucumber-js --require-module ts-node/register --require features/step-definitions/**/*.ts --require features/support/**/*.ts features/**/*.feature --format html:reports/cucumber-report.html --tags
